description: Make an earlier version of a living chart the current one again (the version in between stays in the history, so this can be undone). Its link shows the restored version and attached destinations get a fresh copy. Needs a connection signed in to a free account (connector URL ending in /mcp/account).

id.description: The chart id from create_living_chart or list_my_charts.

name: restore_chart_version
title: Restore chart version
